label: IRIS-W10 (NXP RW612/RW610)

output_power.note: u-blox certified Wi-Fi TX power limits (WW, FCC, ETSI, JP)

calibration.note: Wi-Fi calibration, MCUXpresso SDK 2.16.100 and earlier
Wi-Fi calibration, MCUXpresso SDK 25.06.00 and later

patches.note: MFlash driver for the {flash_vendor} {flash_size} part on {variant}
MFlash driver header for the {flash_vendor} {flash_size} part on {variant}

regulatory.api: wlan-set-regioncode <code>   (Wi-Fi CLI), or the equivalent wlan_set_country_code() call
regulatory.when: after the WLAN subsystem is up
notes: The region code selects which certified table inside wlan_txpwrlimit_cfg_WW_rw610.h is activated.

mac.source: RW612/RW610 OTP, programmed in u-blox production
notes: In the application, wlan_get_mac_address() returns it after wlan_start().

runtime: wlan_set_sta_mac_addr(mac);   /* after Wi-Fi init; wlan_set_mac_addr() also derives the uAP address */

permanent.note: The OTP address is programmed by u-blox in production and is not rewritten from the host.

examples.name: read-mac-address
examples.description: Print the Wi-Fi STA MAC address

examples.name: read-otp-parameters
examples.description: Print the module type and serial number from OTP

manual_steps.text: SDK 24.12.00 / 25.03.00: add '#define CONFIG_WLAN_CALDATA_1ANT 1' to the example's wifi_config.h, otherwise the u-blox Wi-Fi calibration is not used.
SDK 25.06.00 and later: add '#define OVERRIDE_CALIBRATION_DATA "wifi_cal_data_override.h"' to the example's wifi_config.h, otherwise the u-blox Wi-Fi calibration is not used.

manual_steps: Linker scripts for the {flash_size} part are in mcuxpresso/iris-w10/sw-config/linker-scripts/ - the destination depends on the toolchain, so they are not applied automatically.
EVK LED/button pin mux is in mcuxpresso/iris-w10/sw-config/board-files/ - copy into the example's board/ folder if you need it.

notes: wlan-get-txpwrlimit <subband> must report the u-blox values, not the NXP reference board values.
